## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (typecheck, lint, tests, build).
- [ ] New or changed code has a fixture test; unit tests do not need a live session.
- [ ] The diff contains no real course data, ids, names, tokens or session files.
- [ ] `docs/tools.md` regenerated with `npm run docs:tools` if tools changed.
- [ ] README, docs or `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] Write actions (if any) go through a `prepare_*` and `confirm_*` pair.
